### H-023 — Sweep batch Action-Pack artefacts generated for the wrong patient

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-023                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Description**                 | The Sweep module (from v3.56.0) generates batch Action-Pack artefacts — blood-form requests, recall SMS messages, letters, and tasks — for all action-needed patients in a sweep run. An artefact generated for patient A is acted upon for patient B (wrong-patient action), or an artefact is acted upon without the user verifying the patient identity it was generated for.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Potential causes**            | Batch-generated artefacts are listed by patient row; a user scrolling quickly through a long list may apply an artefact to the wrong row; a user copies text from an artefact and pastes it into the wrong Medicus record; the Sweep run is stale (limitation 26) so the artefact was generated for a monitoring state that has since changed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Affected users / components** | Reception and admin staff using the Sweep batch Action-Pack output. Components: `side-panel/modules/sweep/sweep.js`, `side-panel/modules/shared/action-packs.js`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Initial severity**            | 4 (Major — a blood test booked for the wrong patient or a recall SMS sent to the wrong patient could constitute a wrong-patient clinical action)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2 (Unlikely — each artefact row carries the patient's name and NHS number; deliberate wrong-patient verification is required to act)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Initial risk**                | 8                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) Every batch artefact carries the patient's name and NHS number in the artefact header — a wrong-patient paste is detectable on reading before acting. (b) The Sweep results display artefacts per patient row (not in a flat merged list), so each row's context is visible. (c) Per-row patient identity must be verified against the Medicus record before acting on any artefact — stated in the limitation notice (limitation 29 in `CLINICAL-SAFETY-NOTICE.md`) and as a note on the Sweep results display. (d) Artefacts are point-in-time (limitation 26): if a patient's record changes after the sweep, the artefact may be outdated; the Sweep results display the run timestamp and advise re-running if records may have changed. (e) The same wrong-patient controls that apply to single-chip Action Packs (H-001 controls) apply in the batch context. (f) Reception staff must be briefed during induction that batch artefacts require per-patient identity verification. (g) **Practice letterhead auto-fill with blank-guard (v3.107.0):** recall letters and SMS sign-offs substitute the configured practice letterhead/sign-off; where a field is blank the substitution **keeps the `[placeholder]`** rather than silently emitting an empty or wrong value, so a half-configured letterhead is visible on reading before the artefact is sent. **v3.158.0 extension — Monitoring 'Create task' button:** the same one-patient/one-explicit-confirm task creation added to the Sentinel action bar for the OPEN patient; the form permanently names the patient it was opened for, and the submit handler re-checks the currently-followed patient UUID against the one captured at form-open (auto-follow switching patients mid-form invalidates the submit instead of creating a wrong-patient task). |
| **Residual severity**           | 4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Residual risk**               | 8 — Acceptable (ALARP), with explicit deploying-organisation duty to brief reception staff on per-patient identity verification                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted, subject to the practice briefing reception and admin staff that every batch artefact must be verified against the correct patient record before acting. Any report of a wrong-patient artefact action is treated as a significant safety event and triggers immediate CSO review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

### H-024 — Reception guided capture — over-reliance by non-clinical staff

| Field                           | Value | ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-024                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Description**                 | Non-clinical reception staff using the Reception guided capture pathways treat a full set of "no" answers to the bundled red-flag questions as confirmation that the contact is safe to handle routinely, without escalating to a clinician — when in fact the red-flag list is deliberately short and cannot be exhaustive. A clinically significant presentation is not flagged because its red-flag phrasing does not match any bundled question, or because the caller uses lay terms not recognised by the question set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Potential causes**            | Automation bias applied to a fixed question set; staff not briefed that "no red flags" means "none of these specific flags triggered" not "safe to handle without clinical review"; pathways enabled without practice CSO/GP review and staff briefing; pathway content not reviewed since initial deployment; wrong or stale pathway version active; custom pathways authored without clinical oversight.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Affected users / components** | Non-clinical reception staff and the patients they are supporting. Components: `side-panel/modules/reception/reception.js`, `rules/reception-pathways.json`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Initial severity**            | 4 (Major — a clinically urgent presentation incorrectly managed as routine could lead to delayed treatment)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2 (Unlikely — all pathways ship disabled; enablement requires an explicit practice-level disclaimer confirming CSO/GP review and staff briefing; the generated text carries a "not a clinical assessment — clinician to review" footer on every capture)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Initial risk**                | 8                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) All Reception capture pathways **ship disabled**. A practice administrator must click through an explicit disclaimer confirming that a clinician (CSO or nominated GP) has reviewed the pathway content and that staff have been briefed before any pathway can be enabled. (b) Every generated capture output carries a "not a clinical assessment — clinician to review" footer. (c) Red-flag questions are listed first, with any "yes" displaying an immediate 999-level or duty-clinician escalation instruction — a full set of "no" answers does not assert safety, only that none of the specific triggers fired. (d) The Clinical Safety Notice (limitation 27) explicitly states the red-flag lists are short, lay-phrased subsets and cannot be exhaustive. (e) Custom and edited pathways are structurally validated (must include red flags; all red flags must have an escalation level); invalid edits are blocked with the bundled original kept active. (f) The Keeper periodic rule-currency review includes `rules/reception-pathways.json` alongside the other rule files. (g) Pathway `specVersion` enables future non-destructive migration when pathways are updated. (h) The output text embeds the patient's name/DOB so a wrong-record paste is detectable. (i) **Plainer reception copy (v3.111.0):** the reception-facing wording was simplified to reduce misreading by non-clinical staff. (j) **Practice attestation — single "Accept for practice" switch (v3.82.0, v3.87.0):** a single `suite.practiceAcceptedAt` flag can enable off-by-default features (including capture pathways) **practice-wide** rather than per user, so the per-user clinical-review step can be bypassed at the practice level; this is a deliberate convenience for a practice that has done the review centrally, but it concentrates responsibility on whoever sets the flag. The flag propagates via backup and the **restore preview explicitly warns** when an imported backup would enable it; the per-pathway "ship disabled / explicit disclaimer" gate (control (a)) still applies to capture pathways behind the attestation. |

### H-025 — Trends charts — sparse data leading to misread trend

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-025                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Description**                 | A Trends tab chart (BP, Renal/ACR, DOAC CrCl, HbA1c, Cholesterol, or Weight) is displayed with only one or two data points, insufficient to draw a meaningful trend line. A user interprets the resulting chart as a clinically meaningful trend (e.g. a two-point decline interpreted as a progressive fall in eGFR or HbA1c, or a two-point CrCl movement as a dosing cue) and acts on it without reviewing the underlying data and the patient's full clinical context.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Potential causes**            | Patient has few recorded values for the metric (new registration, recent investigation start, sparse recording pattern); the investigation dashboard has not fully loaded for the current session, so only the most recently polled values are available; a metric name change in Medicus means historical values no longer match the expected string.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians and any user reviewing Trends tab charts. Components: `side-panel/modules/trends/trends.js`, `side-panel/modules/trends/doac-core.js`, `side-panel/modules/shared/trend-chart.js`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a misread two-point trend might prompt unnecessary investigation or, conversely, false reassurance about a single high value)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 3 (Possible — sparse data is common in some patient cohorts and for some metrics)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Initial risk**                | 9                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) The chart displays the number of readings and date range, so a user can see that a "trend" is based on two points. (b) Trend tabs require multiple historical readings — a patient with only one recorded value shows "no trend" rather than a single-point misleading chart. (c) The Trends tab data requires the Medicus investigation dashboard to have loaded; if it has not, the tab shows no data rather than a partial subset. (d) Trend data is cleared on every patient navigation (cross-patient guard). (e) The Clinical Safety Notice (limitation 24) states that trends require multiple readings. (f) Verification against the full investigation history in the Medicus record is required before any clinical action informed by a trend chart. (g) v3.245.0 DOAC CrCl is Cockcroft-Gault from shown inputs, fail-closed on any missing/ambiguous input, labelled as not eGFR and not a dosing decision, and never used to hide or re-band Sentinel monitoring (D-001). |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Residual risk**               | 6 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted. Trend charts are supplementary displays of data already present in the Medicus investigation dashboard; clinical interpretation requires review of the source record.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### H-026 — Triage Lens red-flag engine expansion — false-negative reliance

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-026                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Description**                 | Following the v3.46.0 expansion of the Triage Lens rule set (52 additional rules) and subsequent additions, a non-clinical user or clinician treats the absence of a red-flag chip as reassurance that the presenting request is not a clinical emergency — when in fact the rule set cannot cover all possible phrasings of a clinical emergency, and an urgent presentation expressed in unusual terms may produce no chip.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Potential causes**            | Request text uses lay terms, abbreviations, or clinical language not matched by the implemented regex patterns; a clinical emergency is embedded within a longer request text and the relevant phrasing appears in a position or combination not matching any pattern; a pattern is valid regex but the engine silently skips it (mitigated by v3.52.0 dropped-pattern warning); the presentation is genuinely outside the implemented rule set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Affected users / components** | Non-clinical staff handling patient requests via the triage queue; clinicians using the Triage Lens as a rapid screening aid. Components: `content-scripts/triage-lens/content.js`, `content-scripts/triage-lens/defaults.json`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Initial severity**            | 4 (Major — a missed red flag in a clinical emergency context could contribute to delayed escalation)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2 (Unlikely — the rule set is broad and covers the highest-prevalence UK GP red-flag presentations; dropped-pattern warnings make silent engine gaps visible; the Triage Lens is supplementary to the clinical review of every contact)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Initial risk**                | 8                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) The Triage Lens is a supplementary aide-mémoire; all contacts are reviewed by a clinician regardless of chip output. (b) The Clinical Safety Notice (limitation 30) explicitly states that absence of a chip is not absence of risk. (c) From v3.52.0 a pattern that fails to compile logs a `console.warn` naming the rule and pattern, and a rule left with zero usable patterns logs that it will never fire — silent engine gaps are no longer invisible. (d) The DKA/HHS-specific subset of the diabetes rule was promoted to a **red** chip (v3.52.0) after the prior amber-chip/999-note mismatch was identified, reducing the risk of triage under-escalation for a specific high-risk subgroup. (e) The expanded rule set (v3.46.0) was adversarially verified for over-broad patterns (guards against "confused about my medication", "my eye is red", "hangover" triggering false-positive emergency chips); both under- and over-triggering were assessed. (f) `test-triage-rule-patterns.js` pins schema invariants and ~90 positive/negative match examples for high-risk rules, running under the engine's exact wrapping semantics — a silently-invalid pattern causes a test failure, not a missing chip. (g) Staff using the Triage Lens are required to have read and accepted the Clinical Safety Notice, including the "absence of a chip is not absence of risk" principle. |
| **Residual severity**           | 4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Residual risk**               | 8 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted. Any report of a clinically significant missed triage red flag is treated as a significant safety event, triggers immediate CSO review, and may prompt a rule addition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
