### H-027 — Resumed Sweep treated as current (stale worklist)

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-027                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Description**                 | From v3.60.0 the last Sweep run (results and batch selections) persists locally for up to 2 hours so that a tab switch or panel reload does not destroy the morning worklist. A user resumes a previous run and treats it as the current state of the records — arranging recalls, generating handouts or batch Action-Pack artefacts from data that is up to 2 hours old, during which bloods may have been filed, medications changed, or appointments altered.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Potential causes**            | User resumes out of convenience rather than re-running; user does not register the run timestamp on the resume card; a colleague re-ran the sweep on another workstation (runs are per-workstation, so the local copy does not reflect it).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians and reception/admin staff using the Sweep worklist. Components: `side-panel/modules/sweep/sweep.js` (`sweep.lastRun`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — the consequence is an unnecessary or missed _administrative_ booking action; the artefacts are booking/recall instructions, not clinical decisions, and limitation 26's point-in-time caution already applies to a fresh run)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 3 (Possible — resuming is the convenient default within the window)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Initial risk**                | 9                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) The resume card displays the run time and clinician filter ("Last sweep HH:MM …"), so staleness is visible at the point of choice. (b) The stored run expires after 2 hours and is deleted on sight thereafter; resume is then impossible. (c) A fresh "Run sweep" replaces the stored run — resume never wins over a newer run on the same workstation. (d) The Clinical Safety Notice (limitations 26 and 34) instructs users to re-run rather than resume when currency matters, and the existing "point-in-time snapshot" caution applies to all sweep output. (e) The stored run is a per-workstation working copy, excluded from suite backups, and carries the same per-patient identity display as a fresh run (H-023 controls unchanged). |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Residual risk**               | 6 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted. The resume window is deliberately short (2h); the alternative — losing the worklist on every tab switch — was itself a driver of re-run errors and workflow abandonment.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### H-028 — Clinic mode delays awareness of operational alerts

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-028                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Description**                 | From v3.60.0 a user can temporarily mute the extension's desktop pop-up notifications and notification sounds ("clinic mode": 30 minutes, 1 hour, or until 18:00). During a muted period the user is not interrupted by pop-ups for triage-threshold crossings or new-request notifications and may become aware of a building triage queue later than they otherwise would. A secondary risk is forgetting that clinic mode is active.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Potential causes**            | User enables clinic mode for a consultation block and does not glance at the panel strips during it; user forgets the mute is active (mitigated by auto-expiry and the visible pill); user expects "until 18:00" to behave differently around the 18:00 boundary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Affected users / components** | Users who enable clinic mode. Components: `shared/quiet-mode.js`, `side-panel/panel.js` (notification emission), `service-worker.js` (RM notifications), Options → Notifications.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — the muted channels are operational/administrative pop-ups; the underlying strips, badges, and all clinical chip surfaces continue to display and update throughout, and desktop notifications are themselves a best-effort channel the browser may suppress)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 3 (Possible — muting during consultations is the feature's intended use)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Initial risk**                | 9                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) **Bounded scope, enforced in code:** the quiet check exists only at the desktop-notification/sound emission points; strips, toolbar badge, nav badges, Sentinel chips, Triage Lens HUD and in-module banners are architecturally incapable of being muted by clinic mode. (b) The active state is continuously visible as a 🔕 pill in the panel (and pop-out) header showing the expiry time; one click cancels it. (c) Clinic mode always expires automatically; there is no indefinite mute. (d) An "Until 18:00" selection made after 18:00 rolls to the next day rather than silently failing to activate. (e) Alert events that fire during a muted period are still recorded in the recent-alerts log (Today tab), so a muted hour is reviewable afterwards. (f) The settings UI states the boundary verbatim: "Clinic mode silences desktop pop-ups and sounds only. On-screen strips, badges and clinical alerts in the patient record are never muted." (g) The Clinical Safety Notice (limitation 32) and the deployment briefing list (§9.1) cover the residual need to glance at the panel during a muted period. (h) **Focus/Zen mode (v3.94.0) reaffirms the same boundary:** focus mode hides UI chrome and the calm (green/info) strips only — it can NEVER hide the amber or red demand/alert strips, which continue to display, so de-cluttering the panel cannot suppress an active operational alert. (i) **Alert roll-up bar (v3.95.0–v3.97.0):** the three demand strips can collapse to a single severity bar, but a red state auto-expands the bar and colourblind shape cues accompany colour — collapsing the strips reduces clutter without hiding a red alert. |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Residual risk**               | 6 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted. The failure direction is conservative: a fault in clinic mode's activation leaves notifications ON (fail-open). The alternative — users disabling notification channels permanently to manage interruption load — carries a worse and unbounded version of the same risk (see H-012 control g).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

### H-029 — Reception capture draft restored against the wrong contact

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-029                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Description**                 | From v3.60.0 an in-progress reception guided capture is auto-saved as a local draft (≤4 hours) so a tab switch does not destroy a 10–15 question phone capture. A receptionist taking a _different_ patient's call later restores the earlier draft and submits a generated history that mixes two contacts' information, or attributes one caller's answers to another.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Potential causes**            | Busy front desk with interleaved calls; the receptionist recognises the pathway tile's "draft" pill and assumes it relates to the current caller; a colleague's draft is restored on a shared workstation profile.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Affected users / components** | Non-clinical reception staff; the clinician reviewing the generated text. Components: `side-panel/modules/reception/reception.js` (`reception.captureDraft`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Initial severity**            | 4 (Major — wrong-context documentation in a structured complaint description could mislead the reviewing clinician, analogous to H-023's wrong-patient class)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2 (Unlikely — restoring requires an explicit choice from a time-stamped banner, and the draft is scoped to a single pathway)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Initial risk**                | 8                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) Restore is never automatic: a banner showing the draft's saved time offers an explicit "Restore / Discard" choice, and discard deletes the draft. (b) The draft is scoped to one pathway; opening a different pathway does not surface it. (c) The draft expires after 4 hours and is deleted on sight thereafter; generation or discard clears it immediately. (d) The existing wrong-patient-paste control is unchanged: when a patient record is open, the patient's name/DOB is embedded in the generated text header so a wrong-record paste is detectable on reading (limitation 27). (e) Every capture is reviewed by a clinician against the actual contact — the output remains an unverified structured complaint description, never clinical findings. (f) The Clinical Safety Notice (limitations 27 and 34) requires staff to confirm a draft belongs to the current contact before restoring, and this is added to the deployment briefing list. (g) The draft is a per-workstation working copy excluded from suite backups. |
| **Residual severity**           | 4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Residual risk**               | 4 — Acceptable                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted — monitor. Any report of a mixed-contact capture is treated as a significant event and will prompt reconsideration of the draft feature's design (e.g. embedding caller identity in the draft banner).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| **Description**                 | From v3.62.0 the Triage Lens decorates the Investigation Results filing queue with per-row severity chips (urgent/abnormal/under-prioritised/unmatched) derived from each report's own analyte reference-range flags fetched from the Medicus API. From v3.63.0 result severity may additionally be raised by user-authored analyte-threshold rules (for example "Potassium ≥6.0 → red") configured in the Triage Lens settings. From v3.64.0 result severity may additionally be raised by **text-classification rules** for microbiology/culture results (which carry no numeric high/low flag): a built-in MSU/urine-culture rule flags any culture "Needs review" (amber) unless the combined result text contains a configured normal phrase (e.g. "No growth"), in which case it shows a calm "No growth" **info chip**. This info chip asserts a negative culture from the actual result text; it is **not** a verdict that the result is safe to file. Known edge cases the clinician must be aware of: (i) sterile pyuria — a culture may show no growth despite significant pyuria; and (ii) "no significant growth — repeat if symptomatic" contains a no-growth phrase but may warrant a repeat. The normal-phrase list is conservative and clinician-editable. Text-classification rules are escalate-only. From v3.93.0 result severity may additionally be raised by **combo rules** — multi-condition rules that fire only when several analyte conditions are all satisfied on the same report (flagship: built-in `base-urine-sterile-pyuria`, which fires amber when urine microscopy pus/white cells exceed a numeric threshold AND the urine culture text reads negative — the classic sterile-pyuria pattern that the per-analyte chips would otherwise miss). A fired combo is **escalate-only/amber** and shows its own attributable `queue.resultCombo` chip carrying the combo label. Combo rules are **fail-safe on missing data**: a combo whose numeric condition cannot be evaluated (e.g. the microscopy value is absent or unparseable) simply does not fire — a potential **false-negative** (no combo chip on a report that, with full data, would have matched), never a false-positive. A clinician may (a) treat the ABSENCE of a chip as positive assurance that a result is normal or safe to file, or (b) rely on the chip summary instead of opening and reviewing the full report.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Potential causes**            | a row's detail fetch fails or times out (chip silently absent); the whole-queue sweep is throttled (concurrency limit / per-minute budget) so some rows are not yet chipped when the user scans; the laboratory did not set `requiresUrgentReview` on a result that is in fact clinically urgent; an analyte value is unparseable; a result is clinically significant in a way reference-range flags do not capture (e.g. a within-range value that is a large change from the patient's baseline).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians filing investigation results. Components: `content-scripts/triage-lens/content.js` (queue result triage), `engine/result-severity.js`, `engine/normalisers.js` (`normaliseInvestigationReport`), `engine/api-client.js` (`fetchInvestigationReport`), `content-scripts/triage-lens/page-world.js`.                     |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2 (Unlikely — the feature design explicitly provides no "all normal" chip; fetch failures are the most plausible route to absence without abnormality)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Initial risk**                | 8                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) Chips are **additive attention only** — they flag urgent/abnormal/under-prioritised/unmatched; there is deliberately **no "all normal / safe to file" chip**, so the absence of a chip asserts nothing and is never assurance. (b) Severity is **lab-flag-led**: red is the laboratory's own `requiresUrgentReview`; amber is the laboratory's own above/below-reference-range flags. From v3.63.0 severity may additionally be raised by **user-authored analyte-threshold rules**: these are **escalate-only** (the engine takes the more-severe of lab-flag vs user-rule and can never lower or suppress a laboratory urgent or abnormal flag); rules are **validated on save/import**; LLM-generated and manually-authored rules **arrive disabled** and a clinician must review and enable each rule before it fires; chip colour and enable/disable are user-configurable via the existing systemChips editor but the kind-based colour model preserves the red/amber salience. From v3.64.0 severity may additionally be raised by **text-classification rules** for microbiology/culture results: a built-in MSU/urine-culture rule ships **enabled** with a conservative normal-phrase list; it flags cultures "Needs review" (amber) unless the result text matches a normal phrase, showing a "No growth" info chip instead. Text rules are **escalate-only** (can only raise severity to amber or show an info chip; cannot lower or suppress a lab urgent or abnormal flag). The "No growth" info chip is an assertion of a negative culture from result text only — it is **not** a safe-to-file verdict; the clinician must still open and review the report, aware of edge cases (sterile pyuria, "no significant growth — repeat if symptomatic"). The built-in normal-phrase list is conservative and clinician-editable. User-authored text rules (manual or LLM-imported) arrive **disabled** and require clinician review and enablement before firing, under the same review-gate model as threshold rules. Microbiology text matching is case-insensitive substring against the result name (to select cultures) and the combined result text (resultValue + interpretation + lab comments) for the normal phrase. From v3.93.0 **combo rules** (multi-condition; flagship built-in `base-urine-sterile-pyuria`) are likewise **escalate-only** (a fired combo can only raise severity to amber and show the attributable `queue.resultCombo` chip; it can never lower or suppress a lab urgent/abnormal flag) and **fail-safe**: a combo whose numeric condition has no parseable value does **not** fire, so the residual risk is a false-negative (missing chip), not a false-positive — and the underlying lab reference-range flags for that report are unaffected and still chip independently. Combo rules are user-reviewable/editable via the same systemChips + result-rules editors; they add attention, never assurance, and never file or action a result. (c) **Fail-silent:** any fetch or parse error yields no chip and never a wrong chip; the underlying Medicus result and its native filing workflow are unchanged. (d) The chip **never files, changes status, or takes any action** — filing remains a manual clinician action in Medicus. (e) The **under-prioritised** flag exists specifically to surface, not suppress, the case where the lab/requester priority understates result severity. (f) The Clinical Safety Notice (limitation 35) states the chips are a prioritisation aid that does not replace opening and reviewing each report, that user threshold rules escalate only and must be clinician-reviewed before they fire, that the "No growth" info chip is not a safe-to-file verdict and edge cases apply, and that the absence of a chip is not assurance. (g) **Result-rule control lineage (v3.65.0–v3.93.0):** the control set accreted across releases without weakening the lab-flag-led, escalate-only, fail-open/fail-safe design — base result rules enabled escalate-only (v3.65.0); red-only + attributable chips + `suppressIfProblem` fail-open (v3.66.0); specimen-scope fail-open (v3.88.0); combo/multi-condition rules + sterile-pyuria, escalate-only and fail-safe on missing data (v3.93.0); the result inspector authoring tool (v3.88.0–v3.92.0) operates in memory only. abnormalText handling is add-only and never calms a result, the culture false-calm path was hardened, and the shared live matcher removed the prior preview/runtime divergence so the chip a clinician sees in the queue matches what the engine computes. (h) **Critical-low Hb red threshold lowered 100→80 g/L (v3.100.0, CSO-approved):** the red haemoglobin critical-low threshold was lowered from 100 to 80 g/L; result-rule chips now carry the **triggering threshold in their label** so the clinician sees the exact value the chip fired on. This is a clinical-threshold change, recorded here and against H-003. |
| **Residual severity**           | 4 | **Acceptability**               | Accepted. The no-"all-normal"-chip design is the primary control. Any report of a clinically significant missed result attributable to chip absence is treated as a significant safety event and triggers immediate CSO review.
