### H-031 — Same patient, different clinical score on two surfaces (cross-surface scoring divergence)

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-031                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Description**                 | The same clinical instrument is computed on more than one surface (e.g. the live in-queue Triage Lens HUD and the record/engine view) and the surfaces disagree, so a patient shows a benign score on one surface and a concerning score on the other. The motivating, now-closed instance: until v3.114.0 the in-queue anticholinergic-burden (ACB) chip used a separate hardcoded drug table in `content-scripts/triage-lens/content.js` that had drifted from the canonical scorer `engine/acb-scores.js` — strong anticholinergics (olanzapine, quetiapine, clozapine, chlorpromazine, clomipramine, doxepin, diphenhydramine, procyclidine, trihexyphenidyl) and dosulepin scored **0 in the queue HUD but 3 in the record/engine view**, and the queue summed once per drug-class rather than per drug. A clinician triaging from the queue could be falsely reassured by a low/absent ACB chip that the record view would have flagged. The same class of risk applies to any future duplicated clinical computation (STOPP/START term lists, PINCER tables).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Potential causes**            | Two independent encodings of the same clinical concept maintained by hand and allowed to drift; a missing brand/generic in one copy but not the other (silent under-match); divergent thresholds or per-item scoring between copies; a producer→consumer field-name/shape mismatch causing a chip to render the wrong value or not at all.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians triaging from the live queue and cross-referencing the record. Components: `content-scripts/triage-lens/content.js`, `engine/acb-scores.js`, `engine/stopp-start.js`, `visualiser-core.js` (PINCER/high-risk tables), `shared/chip-renderer.js`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a clinical-burden score under-stated on one surface; intercepted by record review and by Medicus's own systems)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 3 (Possible — duplicated hand-maintained tables drift silently, as this one had)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Initial risk**                | 9                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) **Single source of truth (v3.114.0):** the in-queue ACB chip now delegates to the one canonical scorer `engine/acb-scores.js` (`window.ACBScores.computeACB`); the divergent inline table is removed, so the queue and the record score identically by construction, and per-drug additive scoring (the correct clinical model) is used on both. dosulepin/dothiepin (a definite score-3 TCA, previously absent from the engine) was added so consolidation did not regress it. (b) **Completeness CI (v3.114.0):** `test-term-coverage.js` + `rules/term-coverage-snapshot.json` guard the hand-maintained class-term lists (ACB, STOPP NSAID/aspirin) and assert the queue delegates to the engine — a re-introduced separate table or a silently-dropped term fails CI. (c) **Producer→consumer contract tests (v3.114.0):** `test-chip-contract.js` drives the real engine producers into the real renderers for every chip type and asserts each renderer reads exactly the fields the engine emits, so a field-name/shape drift between a clinical producer and its on-screen consumer fails CI. (d) The STOPP NSAID/aspirin term lists were brought to full UK class parity in the same release (see H-016 control (i)), closing the matching silent-gap on that instrument. (e) The standing controls under H-002/H-016 (source-record verification, "absence is not assurance", deterministic engine, single rules engine reused across surfaces) continue to apply. |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Residual risk**               | 3 — Acceptable                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted. The motivating ACB divergence is closed at source (single scorer) and locked by completeness + contract CI. The residual risk is a future newly-duplicated computation; the CI guards make such a divergence fail the build rather than ship silently.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### H-032 — Record tab live snapshot misread as a complete record

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-032                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Description**                 | The Record tab (v3.109.0; "Copy summary" v3.114.0) shows a live API snapshot of the open patient — demographics, problems, medications (with overdue/review flags), recent results, ACB/STOPP prompts and the live drug-monitoring + QOF chips. A clinician treats an omitted section as a negative finding (for example, reads the absence of an allergy, immunisation or consultation as "no known allergies / not immunised / no recent consultation"), or copies the summary and treats it as a complete record rather than a partial, point-in-time view.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Potential causes**            | A section the suite does not retrieve (allergies, immunisations, consultations) is read as empty rather than not-fetched; the snapshot is point-in-time and the record changes after it is taken; the copied summary is pasted elsewhere and read out of context without its provenance header; automation bias (the same root as H-007) applied to a single consolidated view that _looks_ like a record.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians using the Record tab in the side panel or pop-out. Components: `side-panel/modules/record/record.js`, `shared/provenance.js`, the shared API client and normalisers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a missed allergy/immunisation read as a negative finding could lead to an inappropriate action, normally intercepted by Medicus and by source-record verification)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2 (Unlikely — the gap-markers and the persistent banner are present on every render)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Initial risk**                | 6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) A **persistent "live snapshot, not a complete record" banner** is shown on the tab at all times. (b) Sections the suite does not retrieve (allergies, immunisations, consultations) render as **explicit GAP-MARKERS** — absence is shown as "not retrieved", **never** as "none" — so an omission cannot be misread as a negative finding. (c) The **"Copy summary"** action emits plain text with a **provenance header** and a **no-fabrication caveat**, so a pasted summary carries its own context and cannot claim to be more complete than it is. (d) **Provenance canon (`shared/provenance.js`) with a no-silent-drop fallback** stamps the data source and never silently omits a value (see H-007 control (m)). (e) The standing H-007 automation-bias controls and the "single most important rule" (verify against the source record before any clinical action) apply in full. |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Residual risk**               | 6 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted (ALARP). The gap-markers (absence ≠ none) and the persistent snapshot banner are the primary controls. Any report of an omitted section being read as a negative finding is treated as a significant safety event and triggers CSO review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

### H-033 — CQC Inspection Readiness evidence pack misread as compliance proof or population coverage

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-033                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Description**                 | The CQC Inspection Readiness page (v3.110.0; Settings entry v3.110.2) turns the shipped rule-set and currency dates into CQC evidence — an internal readiness check and a gated, inspector-facing export. An inspector or manager reads the rule-counts and currency dates as **proof of compliance**, or as evidence of **patient-population coverage** (i.e. that the practice's actual cohorts have been checked), when the suite is read-only and **cannot enumerate cohorts** — the pack reflects what rules ship and when reference data was current, not the state of any real patient population.                                                                                                                          |
| **Potential causes**            | The export _looks_ authoritative (counts, dates, branding); a reader assumes a rule's presence means the cohort it targets has been audited; the suite's inability to enumerate patients is not understood; the export is shown out of context to a third party.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Affected users / components** | Practice managers, CQC leads, inspectors viewing the export. Components: the CQC Inspection Readiness full-tab page and its export, built from shipped rule data only.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a misrepresentation of compliance/coverage is an organisational/governance risk; direct patient harm is indirect and intercepted by the practice's own assurance processes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2 (Unlikely — the "supporting evidence, not proof" disclaimer and the export gate are present)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Initial risk**                | 6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) The page and export carry a **"supporting evidence, not proof"** disclaimer. (b) The inspector-facing export is **gated behind an explicit confirmation** before it can be produced. (c) The pack is **built from shipped rule data only — no patient data and no cohort enumeration** — so it cannot and does not claim population coverage. (d) The v3.114.0 reconciliation adds **"your count: \_\_\_" columns**, making the suite's non-enumeration explicit: the practice must fill in its own figures, which forecloses the reading that the suite has counted the cohort. (e) The Clinical Safety Notice known-limitation for the CQC pack states the pack is supporting evidence, not proof of compliance or coverage. |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Residual risk**               | 6 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted (ALARP). The "supporting evidence, not proof" framing, the rule-data-only construction, and the "your count" reconciliation columns together make the non-enumeration explicit.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

### H-034 — "Select all" bulk-selects the wrong or too many outstanding investigations

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-034                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Description**                 | The "Select all" helper (v3.108.0) injects a bulk-tick button on the Medicus Review Investigation Report page so a clinician can tick every outstanding investigation request at once. A bulk, hard-to-reverse clinical action (clearing/actioning outstanding investigation requests) selects **more than intended** — or the wrong set — because the button ticked rows the clinician did not mean to include.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Potential causes**            | The clinician presses "Select all" without reviewing the full list; the page is paginated/filtered so "all" means more than is visible; a fast workflow leads to an unintended bulk action; the user assumes the button itself performs the Medicus action.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians filing/actioning outstanding investigation requests. Components: the "Select all" content-script injection on the Review Investigation Report page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a bulk action on outstanding investigation requests, normally intercepted by the confirmation step and the clinician still performing the Medicus action)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2 (Unlikely — a mandatory confirmation defaulting to Cancel stands between the button and any effect)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Initial risk**                | 6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) A **mandatory "Are you sure?" confirmation defaulting to Cancel** is always shown before the bulk tick takes effect — the safe default is to do nothing. (b) The button **only ticks checkboxes**; the clinician still performs the actual Medicus filing/action, so the suite never auto-submits or auto-files. (c) Injection is **idempotent** and **never auto-submits**. (d) The Clinical Safety Notice known-limitation for "Select all" states it is a convenience that ticks checkboxes only, behind a confirm-to-proceed gate, and that the clinician must review the selection before acting in Medicus. |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Residual risk**               | 6 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted (ALARP). The Cancel-default confirmation and the tick-only (never auto-submit) design are the primary controls; the clinician remains the actor for the Medicus action.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

### H-035 — One-click "send to routine prescriptions" re-assigns the wrong task, or to the wrong team

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-035                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Description**                 | The routine-prescription button (v3.131.0; control names updated v3.131.3) sends the prescription task currently on screen to the routine requests task list, assigned to a configured team, by **driving the real Medicus UI** (it clicks the same "Save & send to routine requests task list" → "Assign to" → team → "Send to routine list" controls a clinician would). This is the suite's first control that can **commit** a workflow action rather than only display or pre-tick. The hazard is that a task is routed (a) for the **wrong patient/task** because the wrong task was on screen, or (b) to the **wrong team** because the configured team name resolved to an unintended assignee — potentially de-prioritising or misrouting a prescription.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Potential causes**            | The clinician presses the button with the wrong task open; the configured team name partially matches a different team in the "Assign to" list; the macro selects a near-named option; a `[role=option]` list elsewhere on the overview (Clinical History / Reason for exam) is mistaken for the assignee list; in `auto` commit mode there is no confirmation between press and commit; automation bias (H-007) leads to pressing without checking the task or destination.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians authorising/routing prescription requests. Components: `content-scripts/triage-lens/routine-rx-button.js` (the injected button + UI-driving macro).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a misrouted/wrongly-re-assigned prescription task delays correct handling; the receiving team still reviews, and Medicus records the action in its own audit trail)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 3 (Possible)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Initial risk**                | 9                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) **Drives the real Medicus UI** rather than replaying an API call — Medicus's own validation, access control and audit trail fire exactly as for a manual re-assignment; the suite makes no network calls and reads no patient-data values. (b) **Commit gate defaults to `confirm`**, which names the destination team ("Send this prescription to routine requests for '<team>'?") before committing; `manual` mode only pre-fills and the clinician clicks Send to routine list; `auto` (full automation) is **opt-in**. (c) The macro matches controls **only by visible text** and **aborts, clicking nothing further, if any step's control is not found** — it cannot click a wrong control silently. (d) Team is matched by the clinician's **own configured exact team name** (prefers an exact text match over a partial one). (e) The button is **only shown** when the prescription re-assign controls are present on screen. (f) The clinician chooses when to press it and which task is on screen — the suite never selects the patient. (g) **NEW (Phase 1.4):** every macro run, in every commit mode — including `auto`, which previously left no trail — writes a machine-local audit entry (task URL/UUID, team, commit mode, outcome: committed/highlighted/aborted+reason) and mirrors a schema-compliant summary into the shared Event Ledger, so a wrongly-routed task is now attributable and reviewable after the fact even though the routing itself already went through Medicus's own audit trail (control (a)). (h) Confirm and error toasts are **body-fixed next to the pill** so Medicus's action-row overflow cannot clip them, and Vue rebuilding that row cannot auto-Cancel the confirm. (i) Assignee matching is scoped to the Assign-to picker that just opened; Clinical History / Reason for exam `[role=option]` nodes on the overview are ignored. (j) Slash-spacing in the configured team name is treated as an exact match; a different word (Med vs Meds) is not. |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2 (with the default confirm gate and abort-on-not-found; `auto` mode is an explicit user choice that removes the confirm and raises likelihood toward initial)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Residual risk**               | 6 — Acceptable (ALARP) in the default `confirm`/`manual` modes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted (ALARP). The drive-the-real-UI design (preserving Medicus validation and audit), the team-named confirm-by-default gate, and abort-on-not-found are the primary controls. Users who opt into `auto` mode accept the higher residual likelihood; the Clinical Safety Notice should record this as a known limitation. The new audit trail (control (g)) is a detective control, not preventive — it does not change the residual likelihood.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
