### H-039 — Wrong or irrelevant NHS leaflet selected via Quick Leaflet search or the Leaflets tab

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-039                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Description**                 | The Leaflets tab (pre-existing) and, from v3.154.0, the panel-header Quick Leaflet popover (`side-panel/quick-leaflet/quick-leaflet.js`) provide fuzzy text search over a bundled NHS A-Z leaflet index (`rules/nhs-az-index.json`, via `shared/leaflets-utils.js`). The user types a free-text query; the software surfaces the best-matching titles and, on selection, opens the matched title's page on nhs.uk (or copies its link). The hazard is that fuzzy/substring matching under time pressure surfaces a similarly-worded but clinically different entry — wrong condition, wrong drug, wrong formulation, or an adult/paediatric mismatch — which the user then acts on (opens, prints, or hands the link to a patient) without checking the full title against the intended topic.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Potential causes**            | Fuzzy/substring matching promotes a near-miss title above the intended one; short or abbreviated queries match an unintended entry; visually or lexically similar entry names for different conditions; the guaranteed nhs.uk-search fallback row is selected by habit instead of a specific matched entry, or vice versa; mid-triage time pressure (the popover's explicit design intent) reduces the likelihood of reading the full row before acting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Affected users / components** | Any user of the Leaflets tab or the Quick Leaflet popover. Components: `side-panel/quick-leaflet/quick-leaflet.js`, `side-panel/modules/leaflets/leaflets.js`, `shared/leaflets-utils.js`, `shared/io/leaflets-io.js`, `rules/nhs-az-index.json`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Initial severity**            | 2 (Minor — the content is authoritative NHS patient information reached via an external, independently-maintained nhs.uk page; no diagnosis, prescribing decision, or record write is involved; a wrong leaflet is a wrong-information/patient-confusion risk, not a direct clinical action)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 3 (Possible — fuzzy search used at speed mid-triage is the popover's stated use case)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Initial risk**                | 6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) The index is a static, curated, bundled NHS A-Z list; every result links to the authoritative nhs.uk page for that exact title — never to suite-authored, third-party, or dynamically-generated content. (b) Every result row displays the full leaflet title before any action; selection (Enter/click/copy) is an explicit, deliberate per-row user action — nothing opens or copies automatically from a keystroke. (c) The popover applies no patient context and performs no patient-record matching: the query is entirely user-typed, so the clinician chooses the topic, not the software — there is no "suggested for this patient" inference to get wrong. (d) A guaranteed "Search nhs.uk for '‹query›'" fallback row is always present, so an imperfect fuzzy match is never the only path to the intended content; the user can defer to nhs.uk's own search at any time. (e) "Copy link" and "Open" both act on the specific row visible on screen; there is no bulk-send, auto-paste into Medicus, or direct-to-patient transmission from within the extension — any onward use (printing, messaging, pasting into a Medicus letter/SMS) is the clinician's own separate, deliberate action outside the software. (f) The feature makes no clinical recommendation, no diagnosis, and no prescribing decision, and writes nothing to any record; it is a search-and-link tool over static reference content. |
| **Residual severity**           | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Residual risk**               | 4 — Acceptable                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted. The mechanism is a signposting aid to externally-hosted, independently-maintained NHS content, analogous in kind to the existing risk-tool signpost chip (H-019) and Pharmacy First reference snippets — the software computes nothing and asserts nothing about the patient; the full title is visible before any onward action is taken.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

### H-040 — Follow-ups ledger over-trusted as a safety-netting system of record

**Retired v3.255.0.** The Follow-ups tab, Monitoring "Add follow-up reminder" action, and Today follow-ups line were removed. Residual local `followups.entries` (if any) is unread. Controls below describe the product as shipped; they no longer apply.

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-040                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Description**                 | The Follow-ups module (`side-panel/modules/followups/`, v3.160.0) is a machine-local personal reminder ledger: "waiting for X, chase by date Y", resurfaced on the tab and as a Today line when the date passes. The hazard is over-trust: a clinician treats the ledger as the practice's safety-netting system — stops documenting safety-netting in Medicus, or assumes a reminder will follow them to another machine/seat (it will not: the store is deliberately machine-local and excluded from backups), or assumes someone else can see it (nobody else can). A lost or unseen reminder then becomes a missed follow-up the clinician believed was covered.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Potential causes**            | The ledger working well enough to displace Medicus documentation habits; a clinician switching desks/machines and expecting their reminders to travel; browser profile reset/extension reinstall clearing the store; a reminder added for the wrong patient via a mid-form patient switch.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians using the Follow-ups tab or the Monitoring "Add follow-up reminder" action. Components: `side-panel/modules/followups/*`, `sentinel.js` follow-up form, `today.js` follow-ups line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a missed chase on a pending result the clinician believed was safety-netted; the underlying clinical safety-net documented in Medicus is unaffected unless the user stops keeping it)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 3 (Possible — reminder tools reliably displace paper habits, which is both their value and their risk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Initial risk**                | 9                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) **Fixed honest-state header** on the tab: "stored on this machine only … not part of the clinical record and never replaces safety-netting documented in Medicus. Nothing here acts by itself." Not dismissable. (b) The Monitoring form repeats the same disclosure at the point of capture ("a personal reminder on this machine only, not a record entry. Document safety-netting in Medicus as usual."). (c) **Wrong-patient guard** identical to the create-task form: patient captured at form-open, UUID re-checked at save; patient linkage only ever from the record context, never from typed names (manual tab entries are explicitly labelled "unlinked note"). (d) **Open entries are never silently dropped** — pruning removes only done entries (`pruneFollowups`, regression-tested); a lapsed entry stays until the user acts on it. (e) Lapsed entries are the loudest state everywhere (red pill, red Today line) — the product is the broken chain, not reassurance. (f) Machine-locality is stated in the UI (control a), and the store is excluded from backups with a rationale comment enforced by `test-backup-coverage.js`. (g) Ledger writes are audited to the event ledger by patient UUID (`followup-added` / `followup-done`). (h) Nothing ever fires automatically — no notifications, no writes, no tasks; a reminder is only seen when the user looks at Today or the tab. |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 2 (the permanent disclosure copy, never-drop-open pruning and loud lapsed states leave habit displacement as the main residual path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Residual risk**               | 6 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted (ALARP). The status quo this replaces is memory, sticky notes and "the 11pm cold sweat" — all of which fail silently and invisibly. A local ledger that surfaces its own lapses, never drops an open entry, and states its limits on every render is expected to be net protective, provided the copy keeps directing safety-netting documentation into Medicus.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

### H-041 — Smoking-status banner line trusted as current/complete when stale, miscoded or outside the visible window

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-041                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Description**                 | The Sentinel panel's patient banner now carries one derived smoking-status line (`shared/smoking-status.js`, v3.174.0): bucket (current/ex/never/unclear) + recording date from the observations the extension can see (investigation dashboard + ~400-day journal augment). The hazard is over-trust in a DISPLAY of recorded data: a clinician acts on a stale status (patient relapsed/quit since), on a miscoded entry, or reads the absent state ("no entry in the last 13 months") as "never recorded anywhere", when an older status may exist beyond the extension's window. A secondary form: a mis-bucketed ambiguous term (e.g. a cessation-referral code read as ex-smoker) presented with unearned confidence.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Potential causes**            | Old coded entries outside the ~13-month window; status changed since last coding; ambiguous source terms ("tobacco use", "nicotine dependence", cessation-advice codes); conflicting entries; substring bucketing errors.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians using the Sentinel Monitoring tab (panel + pop-out). Components: `shared/smoking-status.js`, `content-scripts/sentinel.js` (snapshot.smoking), `side-panel/modules/sentinel/sentinel.js` (banner line).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a cessation conversation missed, or CVD-risk/interaction reasoning anchored on a stale status; prescribing itself still happens in Medicus with the full record available)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 3 (Possible — smoking codes are exactly the kind of entry that goes stale and ambiguous)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Initial risk**                | 9                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) **Recency always attached** — the line never shows a bucket without its recording date + relative age; an undated entry shows no fabricated recency (tested). (b) **Honest, bounded absence wording** — "no entry in the last 13 months — check record", never "not recorded"/"NO DATA"; the tooltip explicitly rejects the "never recorded" misread (tested). (c) **Conservative bucketing** — only unambiguous terms classify; ambiguous smoking-related terms render "unclear — see record" with the verbatim coded term, never a confident guess (pharmacist-persona ruling; tested against cessation-advice/nicotine-dependence/tobacco-use traps). (d) **Conflicts flagged, not silently resolved** — disagreeing buckets among visible entries append a "multiple entries" marker with a tooltip warning (tested). (e) **Verbatim source term + exact date in the tooltip** — the derived bucket is never the only representation. (f) **Neutral colour both states** — the line can never masquerade as (or dilute) a red/amber safety alert. (g) The banner's standing "Live snapshot, not a complete record. Verify against the patient record before acting." disclaimer sits directly above. (h) Derivation is pure, fail-safe (returns null on any error) and pinned by `test-smoking-status.js` (44 assertions). |
| **Residual severity**           | 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 1 (recency + verbatim term + bounded-absence wording target each misread path directly)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Residual risk**               | 3 — Acceptable (ALARP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Acceptability**               | Accepted (ALARP), pending CSO review of the bucketing term lists. The status quo is the same fact buried in QOF recording-currency cards where every synthetic persona misread it; one dated, honestly-bounded line is expected to be net protective.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| **Description**                 | v3.175.0 introduces the suite's **first persisted per-patient store**: user-authored flags (interpreter required, safeguarding concern, medication-seeking behaviour, or free text) keyed by Medicus patient UUID and displayed on record load (global strip, Monitoring banner, Pt Alerts tab; from v3.176.0 also an on-page banner inside Medicus's own patient header and flag chips on task-queue rows). Hazard forms: (1) a flag renders against the **wrong patient** (stale identity across a SPA navigation, or an NHS-number fallback mismatch); (2) a flag is **out of date or unfounded** (behavioural flags especially can outlive their basis and prejudice care); (3) a flag substitutes for the clinical record (recorded here but never coded in Medicus, so colleagues without the extension never see it); (4) **disclosure** — exported backup files contain patient-identifiable data and could be mishandled; (5) **over-reliance** — absence of a flag (or of the strip) is read as a verified "no concerns" when it only means none recorded or not identified.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Potential causes**            | SPA navigation races; NHS-number-only views; shared/stale backup files imported elsewhere; flags authored without basis or never reviewed; strip hidden because patient identity could not be resolved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Affected users / components** | All practice users of the panel/pop-out and, from v3.176.0, anyone viewing the Medicus record/queue pages. Components: `side-panel/modules/patient-alerts/*`, `#paStrip` (panel.js), Sentinel banner chips, `shared/io/patient-alerts-io.js`, `content-scripts/patient-alerts-banner.js`, queue `.ch-q-pa` chips (`content-scripts/triage-lens/content.js`), `shared/patient-alerts-lookup.js`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Initial severity**            | 3 (Moderate — a missed safeguarding/interpreter need, prejudiced care from a stale behavioural flag, or a confidentiality breach via a mishandled export) | **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) **Identity resolved at render time, every render** — all three surfaces look flags up from the live Sentinel snapshot's patient context; snapshot invalidation on navigation means a previous patient's flags cannot persist on screen (`test-patient-alerts-core.js` wrong-patient section). (b) **UUID is the only storage key; a name is never a match key**; NHS number is a display-time lookup fallback only and never creates entries. (c) **No affirmative all-clear** — an absent strip/chip row renders nothing (never "no alerts" against a patient that could not be identified); the module's idle state says "no patient identified". (d) **Not-the-record wording in-module** ("Not written to the clinical record — code anything clinically significant in Medicus as usual") plus in-UI guidance that flags are visible to all practice users and disclosable to the patient. (e) **Import can never silently delete** — merge-union semantics; removal is always an explicit in-module act. (f) Export preview and Options card carry a loud patient-identifiable-data warning. (g) Corrupt entries degrade to skipped, never to a broken render; all transforms are pure and pinned by 104 assertions across three test files. (h) v3.176.0 **attribution + audit trail**: every flag carries createdBy/updatedBy (letterhead clinician name; null when unset, never guessed), edits preserve the original author/date as immutable provenance, and every add/edit/remove is recorded in the machine-local Event Ledger (source 'patient-alerts', patient by UUID only, preset-id label — never free text). (i) v3.176.0 on-page banner re-resolves identity from the live page on every render and is REMOVED when identity or flags are absent; queue chips match on resolved patient UUID only (no name/NHS surface is trusted on queue rows); both surfaces are read-only over the store. (j) The two matching implementations (panel ES core vs content-script lookup) are pinned to agree by a parity test (test-patient-alerts-lookup.js), so the wrong-patient matching rules cannot drift between surfaces. |
| **Residual severity**           | 3 ### H-043 — Inline booking/task widget writes to the wrong patient after a mid-flight SPA navigation

| Field                           | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hazard ID**                   | H-043                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Description**                 | The inline booking and task-creation widgets (the suite's only clinical WRITE paths besides lab filing) resolved task→patient asynchronously; a resolution still in flight when the SPA swapped tasks landed the PREVIOUS patient's ID in the NEW task's state, and the cached short-circuit then booked an appointment / created a task on the wrong record with nothing on screen revealing it. Found and fixed by the 2026-07-18 audit (its Critical C1).                                                                                |
| **Potential causes**            | SPA task navigation during the open-latency window; state cache short-circuit masking the stale identity at commit.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Affected users / components** | Clinicians using `content-scripts/task-actions-panel.js` (formerly the standalone `booking-inline.js` / `task-inline.js`, merged 2026-08-23 into one floating panel — the controls below were carried over unchanged).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Initial severity**            | 5 (wrong-patient clinical write)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Initial likelihood**          | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Initial risk**                | 10                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Controls / mitigations**      | (a) Per-task state instance pinned across every await — stale resolutions are discarded, never written into a newer task's state. (b) HARD commit-time re-verification: the on-screen task is re-resolved to its patient immediately before the write and must equal the pinned identity, else the action aborts with "reopen the panel" (the same click-time discipline as lab filing). (c) A slot reservation completed during a navigation is released, never attached. (d) waitFor-driven macros (routine-rx) abort on any path change. |
| **Residual severity**           | 5                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Residual likelihood**         | 1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

(c) `test-vaccine-status-terms.js` iterates every rule × every negative phrasing × undated cases and fails CI on any vax_given classification. |
